meta.name: file-organizer
meta.description: Intelligently organizes your files and folders across your computer by understanding context, finding duplicates, suggesting better structures, and automating cleanup tasks. Reduces cognitive load and keeps your digital workspace tidy without manual effort.

copy.tagline: 自动整理电脑文件，清理重复项，优化文件夹结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果桌面和下载文件夹总是乱糟糟，想自动归类文件
copy.tagline_en: Automatically organize files, find duplicates, and optimize folder structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your desktop and downloads folder are always messy and you want automatic file sorting

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的文件和文件夹，找出重复文件，建议更好的结构，并在你批准后自动移动、重命名和整理文件。
howto.when: 当你请求整理某个文件夹（如下载文件夹、文档文件夹），或要求查找重复文件、清理旧文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理下载文件夹，把文件分类放好。
say.note: Claude 会分析并建议整理方案。

say.text: 在文档文件夹里找重复文件，告诉我该删哪些。
say.note: Claude 会列出重复文件并给出建议。

say.text: 清理半年没动过的旧文件。
say.note: Claude 会找出旧文件并询问处理方式。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your files and folders, finds duplicates, suggests better structures, and automatically moves, renames, and organizes files after your approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize a folder (e.g., Downloads, Documents), find duplicates, or clean up old files.

say_en.text: Help me organize my Downloads folder into proper categories.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest an organization plan.

say_en.text: Find duplicate files in my Documents folder and tell me which to delete.
say_en.note: Claude will list duplicates and recommend actions.

say_en.text: Clean up files I haven't touched in 6 months.
say_en.note: Claude will find old files and ask how to handle them.
